import Mathlib

structure BinaryMaxHeap where
  storage : List Int
deriving Inhabited

namespace BinaryMaxHeap

def len (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Nat :=
  h.storage.length

def get (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (i : Nat) : Int :=
  h.storage.getD i 0

def parent (i : Nat) : Nat := (i - 1) / 2

def is_heap (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, 0 < i ∧ i < h.len → h.get i ≤ h.get (parent i)

def view (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Multiset Int :=
  Multiset.ofList h.storage

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def pop_max_precond (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_heap h ∧ h.len > 0
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def insD (x : Int) : List Int → List Int
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if y ≤ x then x :: y :: ys else y :: insD x ys

def sortD : List Int → List Int
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => insD x (sortD xs)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
-- Returns (new_heap, popped_max)
def pop_max (h : BinaryMaxHeap)
    (h_precond : pop_max_precond h) : BinaryMaxHeap × Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (⟨sortD h.storage.tail⟩, h.get 0)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def pop_max_postcond (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (result : BinaryMaxHeap × Int)
    (_ : pop_max_precond h) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let (new_h, max_val) := result
  is_heap new_h ∧
  new_h.len = h.len - 1 ∧
  (∀ x ∈ h.view, max_val ≥ x) ∧
  new_h.view = h.view - {max_val}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma getD_cons_zero' (a : Int) (l : List Int) : (a :: l).getD 0 0 = a := rfl

lemma getD_cons_succ' (a : Int) (l : List Int) (i : Nat) :
    (a :: l).getD (i + 1) 0 = l.getD i 0 := rfl

lemma insD_perm (x : Int) : ∀ (l : List Int), (insD x l).Perm (x :: l) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | cons y ys ih =>
    by_cases hxy : y ≤ x
    · have e : insD x (y :: ys) = x :: y :: ys := by simp [insD, hxy]
      rw [e]
    · have e : insD x (y :: ys) = y :: insD x ys := by simp [insD, hxy]
      rw [e]
      exact (ih.cons y).trans (List.Perm.swap x y ys)

lemma sortD_perm : ∀ (l : List Int), (sortD l).Perm l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have h1 : (insD x (sortD xs)).Perm (x :: sortD xs) := insD_perm x (sortD xs)
    have h2 : (x :: sortD xs).Perm (x :: xs) := ih.cons x
    exact h1.trans h2

lemma insD_pairwise (x : Int) : ∀ (l : List Int),
    l.Pairwise (fun p q => q ≤ p) → (insD x l).Pairwise (fun p q => q ≤ p) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro _
    have e : insD x ([] : List Int) = [x] := rfl
    rw [e]
    simp
  | cons y ys ih =>
    intro hl
    rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hl
    obtain ⟨hy, hys⟩ := hl
    by_cases hxy : y ≤ x
    · have e : insD x (y :: ys) = x :: y :: ys := by simp [insD, hxy]
      rw [e, List.pairwise_cons]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro b hb
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hb with hb' | hb'
        · rw [hb']; exact hxy
        · exact le_trans (hy b hb') hxy
      · rw [List.pairwise_cons]
        exact ⟨hy, hys⟩
    · have hxy' : x ≤ y := le_of_lt (not_le.mp hxy)
      have e : insD x (y :: ys) = y :: insD x ys := by simp [insD, hxy]
      rw [e, List.pairwise_cons]
      refine ⟨?_, ih hys⟩
      intro b hb
      have hb2 : b ∈ x :: ys := (insD_perm x ys).mem_iff.mp hb
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hb2 with hb' | hb'
      · rw [hb']; exact hxy'
      · exact hy b hb'

lemma sortD_pairwise : ∀ (l : List Int), (sortD l).Pairwise (fun p q => q ≤ p) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    have e : sortD ([] : List Int) = [] := rfl
    rw [e]
    simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have e : sortD (x :: xs) = insD x (sortD xs) := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact insD_pairwise x (sortD xs) ih

lemma getD_mem : ∀ (l : List Int) (i : Nat), i < l.length → l.getD i 0 ∈ l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro i hi
    simp at hi
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      rw [getD_cons_zero']
      simp
    | succ k =>
      rw [getD_cons_succ']
      have hk : k < xs.length := by
        rw [List.length_cons] at hi
        omega
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem x (ih k hk)

lemma mem_getD : ∀ (l : List Int) (x : Int), x ∈ l → ∃ i, i < l.length ∧ l.getD i 0 = x := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro x hx
    simp at hx
  | cons y ys ih =>
    intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
    · refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.length_cons]; omega
      · rw [getD_cons_zero', h]
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := ih x h
      refine ⟨i + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.length_cons]; omega
      · rw [getD_cons_succ']; exact he

lemma pairwise_getD_le : ∀ (l : List Int), l.Pairwise (fun p q => q ≤ p) →
    ∀ i j, j ≤ i → i < l.length → l.getD i 0 ≤ l.getD j 0 := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro _ i j _ hi
    simp at hi
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro hl i j hji hi
    rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hl
    obtain ⟨hx, hxs⟩ := hl
    cases j with
    | zero =>
      cases i with
      | zero => exact le_refl _
      | succ k =>
        rw [getD_cons_succ', getD_cons_zero']
        have hk : k < xs.length := by
          rw [List.length_cons] at hi
          omega
        exact hx _ (getD_mem xs k hk)
    | succ j' =>
      cases i with
      | zero => omega
      | succ i' =>
        rw [getD_cons_succ', getD_cons_succ']
        have hi' : i' < xs.length := by
          rw [List.length_cons] at hi
          omega
        exact ih hxs i' j' (by omega) hi'

lemma heap_root_max_aux (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (hh : is_heap h) :
    ∀ n i, i ≤ n → i < h.len → h.get i ≤ h.get 0 := by
  have hh' : ∀ i, 0 < i ∧ i < h.len → h.get i ≤ h.get (parent i) := hh
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro i hin _
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    exact le_refl _
  | succ m ih =>
    intro i hin hilen
    cases i with
    | zero => exact le_refl _
    | succ k =>
      have hplen : parent (k + 1) < h.len := by
        unfold parent
        omega
      have hpm : parent (k + 1) ≤ m := by
        unfold parent
        omega
      have h1 : h.get (k + 1) ≤ h.get (parent (k + 1)) :=
        hh' (k + 1) ⟨Nat.succ_pos k, hilen⟩
      exact le_trans h1 (ih (parent (k + 1)) hpm hplen)

lemma heap_root_max (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (hh : is_heap h) :
    ∀ i, i < h.len → h.get i ≤ h.get 0 := by
  intro i hi
  exact heap_root_max_aux h hh i i le_rfl hi
-- !benchmark @end lemma

    (h_precond : pop_max_precond h) :
    pop_max_postcond h (pop_max h h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hheap : is_heap h := h_precond.1
  have hlen : h.len > 0 := h_precond.2
  obtain ⟨a, rest, hst⟩ : ∃ a rest, h.storage = a :: rest := by

      omega

  have htail : h.storage.tail = rest := by simp [hst]

    show h.storage.getD 0 0 = a
    rw [hst]
    exact getD_cons_zero' a rest
  have hlen' : h.len = rest.length + 1 := by
    show h.storage.length = rest.length + 1
    simp [hst]
  have key : pop_max h h_precond = (⟨sortD rest⟩, a) := by
    show (⟨sortD h.storage.tail⟩, h.get 0) = ((⟨sortD rest⟩ : BinaryMaxHeap), a)
    rw [htail, hget0]
  rw [key]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨hi1, hi2⟩ := hi

      unfold parent
      omega
    have hi2' : i < (sortD rest).length := hi2
    exact pairwise_getD_le (sortD rest) (sortD_pairwise rest) i (parent i) hp hi2'

    rw [hlen', (sortD_perm rest).length_eq]
    simp
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ h.storage := hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hgi⟩ := mem_getD h.storage x hx'
    have hi' : i < h.len := hi
    have h0 : h.get i ≤ h.get 0 := heap_root_max h hheap i hi'
    have hxi : h.get i = x := hgi
    show a ≥ x
    rw [← hxi, ← hget0]
    exact h0
  · show (Multiset.ofList (sortD rest)) = (Multiset.ofList h.storage) - {a}
